statement: Warren 2026-10-07, product-line access rule: every signed-in screen filters to the user's assigned product lines; each assigned line is Read or Read-and-edit; a non-admin user with no assignment sees no product data; an ADMIN sees all product lines (admin bypasses the product-line filter). Differs from the dirty-tree build, where admin does not bypass an empty assignment; N-0065 changes that before closing.
